Artisan Coffee,
Roasted Locally.
Experience the rich, bold flavors of ethically sourced beans, roasted small-batch right here in Seattle. Every cup is crafted with passion and precision.
Our Story

Founded in 2018, Bean & Brew began with a simple mission: to serve the perfect cup. We source our beans directly from sustainable farms in Ethiopia and Colombia, roasting them in-house to unlock their full potential.

Our flagship store in downtown Seattle is designed to be your sanctuary—a place to pause, sip, and savor.
The best morning brew in the city. Absolutely love the atmosphere! The baristas know exactly how to pull the perfect shot.
SARAH JENKINS — LOCAL GUIDE
